title: Fumonisin B1 exposure induces cardiac inflammation in C57BL/6 mice.
authors: Gounder, Selwyn; Mhlongo, Ndumiso; Ghazi, Terisha; Chuturgoon, Anil
one_liner_zh: 该文研究FB1暴露对小鼠心脏炎症和DNA甲基化的影响，仅用分子对接初步预测小分子与炎症蛋白互作，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The increasing prevalence of mycotoxin toxicity poses significant health risks, contributing to various diseases. Among these, fumonisin B1 (FB(1)) alters sphingolipid biosynthesis, induces oxidative stress, apoptosis, mitochondrial dysfunction, and inflammation. This study investigated the impact of acute FB(1) exposure on inflammation and epigenetics changes in hearts of C57BL/6 mice. Molecular docking was performed to identify potential interactions between FB(1) and key inflammatory proteins (TNF-alpha, iNOS, NF-kappaB p65, and NF-kappaB p50). Excised C57BL/6 mice heart tissue was analysed for gene expression (qPCR), protein expression (Western blotting), nitric oxide levels (NOS assay), cytokine levels (ELISA), and global DNA methylation (ELISA). Molecular docking suggested FB(1) interacted with key residues in TNF-alpha, iNOS, and NF-kappaB, potentially influencing their activity. Gene expression analysis (TNF-alpha, NF-kappaB, IL-6, NLRP3 Inflammasome, IL-18, caspase 1, IL-1beta, GSDMD, caspase 3, CT-1, IL-10, MBD2, DNMT1, DNMT3A, and DNMT3B) revealed that FB(1) significantly dysregulated inflammatory cytokines and DNA methylation-related genes. Protein expression analysis showed significant upregulation of pro-inflammatory cytokines (TNF-alpha, NF-kappaB, IL-6, IL-1beta, IL-18, IL-10, and TGF-beta1). Global DNA methylation levels were significantly increased, with notable upregulation of DNMT1. In conclusion, acute exposure of C57BL/6 mice to FB(1) significantly impacted inflammatory and DNA methylation pathways, leading to cardiac distress complications.
abstract_zh: 真菌毒素毒性的日益普遍对健康构成重大风险，导致多种疾病。其中，伏马菌素B1（FB(1)）改变鞘脂生物合成，诱导氧化应激、细胞凋亡、线粒体功能障碍和炎症。本研究探讨了急性FB(1)暴露对C57BL/6小鼠心脏炎症和表观遗传学变化的影响。通过分子对接 (molecular docking) 鉴定FB(1)与关键炎症蛋白（TNF-alpha、iNOS、NF-kappaB p65和NF-kappaB p50）之间的潜在相互作用。对切除的C57BL/6小鼠心脏组织进行了基因表达（qPCR）、蛋白表达（Western blotting）、一氧化氮水平（NOS测定）、细胞因子水平（ELISA）和整体DNA甲基化（ELISA）分析。分子对接提示FB(1)与TNF-alpha、iNOS和NF-kappaB中的关键残基相互作用，可能影响其活性。基因表达分析（TNF-alpha、NF-kappaB、IL-6、NLRP3炎症小体、IL-18、caspase 1、IL-1beta、GSDMD、caspase 3、CT-1、IL-10、MBD2、DNMT1、DNMT3A和DNMT3B）显示，FB(1)显著失调了炎症细胞因子和DNA甲基化相关基因。蛋白表达分析显示促炎细胞因子（TNF-alpha、NF-kappaB、IL-6、IL-1beta、IL-18、IL-10和TGF-beta1）显著上调。整体DNA甲基化水平显著增加，其中DNMT1显著上调。总之，C57BL/6小鼠急性暴露于FB(1)显著影响炎症和DNA甲基化通路，导致心脏窘迫并发症。
